sentences.en: A A few years ago, in one of the most fascinating and disturbing experiments in behavioural psychology, Stanley Milgram of Yale University tested 40 subjects from all walks of life for their willingness to obey instructions given by a ‘leader’ in a situation in which the subjects might feel a personal distaste for the actions they were called upon to perform.
sentences.zh: 几年前,在行为心理学最令人着迷和最令人不安的实验之一,耶鲁大学斯坦利·米尔格拉姆( Stanley Milgram)测试了40个各行各业的科目,因为他们愿意服从 " 领导者 " 的指示,而在这种情况下,这些科目可能感到个人不满意他们被要求采取的行动。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

words.def: 种族主义、仇外心理和仇外心理

sentences.en: Specifically, Milgram told each volunteer ‘teacher-subject’ that the experiment was in the noble cause of education, and was designed to test whether or not punishing pupils for their mistakes would have a positive effect on the pupils’ ability to learn.
sentences.zh: 具体来说,Milgram告诉每个志愿者 " 教师-科目 ",实验是高尚的教育事业,目的是测试是否惩罚犯错的学生,是否会对学生的学习能力产生积极影响。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: B Milgram’s experimental set-up involved placing the teacher-subject before a panel of thirty switches with labels ranging from ’15 volts of electricity (slight shock)’ to ‘450 volts (danger – severe shock)’ in steps of 15 volts each.
sentences.zh: B Milgram的实验设置包括将教师-科目放在一个由30个开关组成的板块上,标签为 " 15伏电(轻微冲击) " 至 " 450伏(危险-严重冲击) ",每步15伏。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The teacher-subject was told that whenever the pupil gave the wrong answer to a question, a shock was to be administered, beginning at the lowest level and increasing in severity with each successive wrong answer.
sentences.zh: 教师-学生被告知,每当学生对问题回答错误时,都会受到冲击,从最低程度开始,每接连回答错误,其严重程度就会增加。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: The supposed ‘pupil’ was in reality an actor hired by Milgram to simulate receiving the shocks by emitting a spectrum of groans, screams and writhings together with an assortment of statements and expletives denouncing both the experiment and the experimenter.
sentences.zh: 假称的「学生」其实是米尔格拉姆雇用的演员, 以模拟受冲击, 发表一连串呻吟、尖叫、写字、各种声明和谴责实验者和实验者等。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Milgram told the teacher-subject to ignore the reactions of the pupil, and to administer whatever level of shock was called for, as per the rule governing the experimental situation of the moment.
sentences.zh: Milgram告诉教师,不要理会学生的反应,按照目前试验情况的规则,不管需要受到何种程度的冲击。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: C As the experiment unfolded, the pupil would deliberately give the wrong answers to questions posed by the teacher, thereby bringing on various electrical punishments, even up to the danger level of 300 volts and beyond.
sentences.zh: C实验展开后,学生会故意对教师提出的问题作出错误的答复,从而带来各种电刑,甚至达到300伏以上的危险程度。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Many of the teacher-subjects balked at administering the higher levels of punishment, and turned to Milgram with questioning looks and/or complaints about continuing the experiment.
sentences.zh: 许多教师-教师科目在接受更高程度的处罚时被压住,然后转向Milgram, 询问其外观和/或抱怨继续实验。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In these situations, Milgram calmly explained that the teacher-subject was to ignore the pupil’s cries for mercy and carry on with the experiment.
sentences.zh: Milgram冷静地解释, 老师的科目是无视学生的求怜之呼,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: If the subject was still reluctant to proceed, Milgram said that it was important for the sake of the experiment that the procedure be followed through to the end.
sentences.zh: 如果主体仍然不愿继续,Milgram说,为了试验,重要的是要将程序一直延续到最后。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: His final argument was, ‘You have no other choice. You must go on.’ What Milgram was trying to discover was the number of teacher-subjects who would be willing to administer the highest levels of shock, even in the face of strong personal and moral revulsion against the rules and conditions of the experiment.
sentences.zh: 他最后的论断是,“你别无选择,你必须继续。 ”米尔格拉姆试图发现的是,即使面对个人和道德强烈反对实验规则和条件的强烈反感,也愿意承受最高程度的冲击的教师-学生人数。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: D Prior to carrying out the experiment, Milgram explained his idea to a group of 39 psychiatrists and asked them to predict the average percentage of people in an ordinary population who would be willing to administer the highest shock level of 450 volts.
sentences.zh: 在进行试验之前,Milgram向一组39名精神病医生解释了他的想法,并要求他们预测普通人口中愿意承受450伏最高冲击水平的普通人口的平均百分比。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The overwhelming consensus was that virtually all the out teacher-subjects would refuse to obey the experimenter.
sentences.zh: 绝大多数的共识是,几乎所有的教师外科都拒绝服从实验者。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The psychiatrists felt that ‘most subjects would not go beyond 150 volts’ and they further anticipated that only four per cent would go up to 300 volts.
sentences.zh: 心理医生认为, " 大多数科目不会超过150伏 ",他们进一步预计只有4%的科目将高达300伏。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Furthermore, they thought that only a lunatic fringe of about one in 1,000 would give the highest shock of 450 volts.
sentences.zh: 此外,他们认为只有大约千分之一的疯子边缘才会造成450伏伏的冲击。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Furthermore, they thought that only a lunatic cringe of about one in 1,000 would give the highest shock of 450 volts.
sentences.zh: 此外,他们认为只有1 000个疯子中就有1个会受到450伏的冲击。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: E What were the actual results?
sentences.zh: E 实际结果是什么?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Well, over 60 per cent of the teacher-subjects continued to obey Milgram up to the 450-volt limit!
sentences.zh: 超过60%的教师继续服从米尔格拉姆,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In repetitions of the experiment in other countries, the percentage of obedient teacher-subjects was even higher, reaching 85 per cent in one country.
sentences.zh: 在其他国家重复试验时,听从教师课程的比例甚至更高,一个国家达到85%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: How can we possibly account for this vast discrepancy between what calm, rational, knowledgeable people predict in the comfort of their study and what pressured, flustered, but cooperative teachers’ actually do in the laboratory of real life?
sentences.zh: 我们如何解释这种巨大的差异, 一方面是冷静、理性、知识渊博的人在学习的舒适度中预测到什么,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: F One’s first inclination might be to argue that there must be some sort of built-in animal aggression instinct that was activated by the experiment, and that Milgram’s teacher-subjects were just following a genetic need to discharge this pent-up primal urge onto the pupil by administering the electrical shock.
sentences.zh: F的第一个倾向可能是说实验必须激发出某种内在的动物攻击本能,而Milgram的教师学科只是因为遗传需要,通过电击将这种被打碎的原始冲动释放给学生。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A modern hard-core sociobiologist might even go so far as to claim that this aggressive instinct evolved as an advantageous trait, having been of survival value to our ancestors in their struggle against the hardships of life on the plains and in the caves, ultimately finding its way into our genetic make-up as a remnant of our ancient animal ways.
sentences.zh: 现代核心社会生物学家甚至甚至可能甚至声称,这种侵略性本能演变为一种有利特征,对我们祖先在平原和洞穴中与生活困苦作斗争时具有生存价值,最终发现其作为我们古老动物方法的残余而进入我们的基因构成。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: G An alternative to this notion of genetic programming is to see the teacher-subjects’ actions as a result of the social environment under which the experiment was carried out.
sentences.zh: G 基因方案拟定概念的另一种办法是,看到教师-科目的行动是实验所根据的社会环境的结果。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: As Milgram himself pointed out, ‘Most subjects in the experiment see their behaviour in a larger context that is benevolent and useful to society – the pursuit of scientific truth. The psychological laboratory has a strong claim to legitimacy and evokes trust and confidence in those who perform there. An action such as shocking a victim, which in isolation appears evil, acquires a completely different meaning when placed in this setting.’
sentences.zh: 正如Milgram本人指出的那样, “ 实验中的大多数实验对象看到他们的行为是在一个更加宽宏大、对社会有利和有益的大背景下 — — 追求科学真理。 心理实验室拥有强烈的合法性,并唤起对实验执行者的信任和信心。 孤立地看似邪恶的令人震惊的受害者的行为在被置于这一环境时获得了完全不同的意义。 ”

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: H Thus, in this explanation the subject merges his unique personality and personal and moral code with that of larger institutional structures, surrendering individual properties like loyalty, self-sacrifice and discipline to the service of malevolent systems of authority.
sentences.zh: 因此,H在解释中,这个主题将他独特的个性和个人道德守则与更大的体制结构的守则结合起来,将忠诚、自我牺牲和纪律等个人财产交给邪恶的权威体系服务。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: I Here we have two radically different explanations for why so many teacher-subjects were willing to forgo their sense of personal responsibility for the sake of an institutional authority figure.
sentences.zh: 在这里,我们有两个截然不同的解释,这就是为什么这么多的教师为了一个机构权威人物而愿意放弃个人责任感。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The problem for biologists, psychologists and anthropologists is to sort which of these two polar explanations is more plausible.
sentences.zh: 生物学家、心理学家和人类学家的问题在于如何分辨这两种极的解释更合理

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This, in essence, is the problem of modern sociobiology – to discover the degree to which hard-wired genetic programming dictates, or at least strongly biases, the interaction of animals and humans with their environment, that is, their behaviour.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说,这是现代社会生物学的问题,即发现硬线基因程序设计在多大程度上决定或至少强烈偏向动物和人类与其环境的相互作用,即其行为。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Put another way, sociobiology is concerned with elucidating the biological basis of all behaviour.
sentences.zh: 社会生物学则关注阐明所有行为的生物学基础。
